Next I’ll check them against the design decisions and whether the jobs can actually run with the current manifests and scripts.review: cursor/grok-4.7 findings:1

Reviewed scope: uncommitted P01.4 changes under `/home/vostrikov/projects/packages/corex` for `.github/workflows/{ci,distribution-proof,remaining-cohort-proof}.yml`, `.github/dependabot.yml`, `.github/CODEOWNERS`, and `.github/zizmor.yml`, checked against `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/phases/P01/P01.4.md`, research `P01-design.md` §4.4, and decisions D37, D39, and D42, plus the token delta in `artifacts/P01.4-execution/token-precondition.json` and `hosted-provider-access.json`. Validation logs were read directly. No push, no Composer update, no live CI.

## Finding 1 — high

**After O-3, `composer update` still dies on the private AzGuard VCS repository.** `AZGUARD_READ_TOKEN` is only in the staging and dependency-analyser steps, and Composer does not read `GH_TOKEN`.

`composer.json` keeps a canonical VCS repository ahead of Packagist:

```87:96:/home/vostrikov/projects/packages/corex/composer.json
    "repositories": {
        "0": {
            "type": "path",
            "url": "packages/*"
        },
        "1": {
            "type": "vcs",
            "url": "https://github.com/axiomasoft/azguard.git"
        }
    },
```

`packages/access/composer.json` has the same VCS URL at lines 80–83. `stage-stancl-providers.py` prepends the local Composer repo and leaves that VCS entry in place. The auth job then prepends it again, at the highest priority, with no token:

```691:692:/home/vostrikov/projects/packages/corex/.github/workflows/ci.yml
      - name: Register public AzGuard GitHub VCS
        run: composer --working-dir=packages/access config repositories.azguard vcs https://github.com/axiomasoft/azguard.git
```

**Failing trigger.** Owner sets a read-only `AZGUARD_READ_TOKEN`. The staging step’s `gh api repos/axiomasoft/azguard/tarball/...` (`private-auth-proof.py:49`) succeeds. The next `composer update` looks up a Packagist package such as `pestphp/pest`. Earlier repos do not contain it, so Composer initializes `https://github.com/axiomasoft/azguard.git`. The private repo returns 404 without Composer `github-oauth`. On a non-interactive runner, Composer 2.8 `GitHubDriver::getContents` (`vendor/composer/composer/.../GitHubDriver.php:484-498`) falls through to `git@github.com:axiomasoft/azguard.git`. The runner has no SSH key, the clone throws, and `composer update` exits non-zero. Every install job stops there. The auth package update fails even sooner, because the re-added VCS repo outranks the staged zip, and a monorepo-root VCS checkout cannot provide `axioma-studio/azguard-core` (`stage-stancl-providers.py:34-35`).

Local `validation-results.json` exit 0 does not cover this. Those commands ran on a credentialed workstation. `hosted-provider-access.json` records `secrets: []` and `provider.private: true`. `token-precondition.json` only shows the staging precondition.

**Minimal repair.** In `stage-stancl-providers.py` `register()`, disable every repository whose URL is `github.com/axiomasoft/azguard` on each root it registers. Delete the `Register public AzGuard GitHub VCS` step. Keep `GH_TOKEN` on the `gh` steps only.

The token handling that is present is sound: workflow `permissions: {}`, job `contents: read`, `persist-credentials: false`, secret only via step `env`, fail-closed `${GH_TOKEN:?...}`, and no credential or grant created. That scope never becomes Composer auth, so the install commands are still not executable after O-3.

## Checked and holding

SHA pins match the tags: `actions/checkout` `3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1` is v7.0.1, `shivammathur/setup-php` `f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240` is 2.37.2, `zizmorcore/zizmor-action` `cc914d7f3750a2d13d75c7f184a1060aa0e9d482` is v0.6.4. At that action SHA the inputs in use are valid: `persona: regular`, `advanced-security: false`, `online-audits: false`, `version: v1.30.1`, `inputs: .github`. Checkout count equals `persist-credentials: false`. No `continue-on-error`, no write grants, no PHP 8.3, no Boxed profile. `tests` is PHP 8.4/8.5 × Laravel `12.*`/`13.*`. `tests-pg` is Postgres 16/18 × Laravel. Other Postgres services are 18. Pest `^4.7` is only on the Laravel 12 arms, including the operations and tenancy working copies that those arms constrain. `composer audit --locked` follows each workflow `composer update`, with the same `--working-dir`. Manifests run `manifest-check.py` and `composer validate --strict --no-check-lock` over the 21 roots. `quality` runs `composer analyse` (`scripts/phpstan-packages.sh` plus the ceiling guard). New jobs `manifests`, `golden`, `ownership`, `dependencies`, and `zizmor` are wired. Dependabot and CODEOWNERS match D39. `.github/zizmor.yml` is `rules: {}`. `zizmor-final.log` and `zizmor-all-final.log` report no findings for zizmor 1.30.1; the “44 suppressed” count is the regular persona’s built-in audit set.

## Deferred, not acceptance

`install-profiles` / `upgrade-proof` still take AzGuard from a local tree (`COREX_AZGUARD_LOCAL`, default `/home/vostrikov/projects/packages/azguard`). `upgrade-proof` sets `GH_TOKEN` from `github.token` for public release lookups. Those `workflow_dispatch` proofs do not call `stage-stancl-providers.py`. `packages-tests` still runs `composer test:packages` after only a root install; several package scripts invoke package-local `pest` or `vendor/autoload.php`. That layout predates this diff. Digest-pinning Postgres images and a live CI run stay with O-3 / later release work.The background search that was still running has finished. I’ll check its result and only follow up if it changes the review.The leftover Composer search ended when the broad filesystem walk was stopped. It had already shown Composer 2.8.3 and the in-repo `AuthHelper.php`, which is what the review used.

That does not change the result: **review: cursor/grok-4.7 findings:1**. After O-3, `composer update` still fails because the private AzGuard VCS repository stays on the resolution path and Composer does not read `GH_TOKEN`.
